**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.node` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeReorderEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/node/NodeReorderEvent.java)

A move of a child in a reorderable list, with the child and its index before and after, in a cancellable `Pre` and a `Post`.

## Description

[`ReorderableFlexNode`](/reference/layout/reorderableflexnode/) fires `onReorderStart` when a drag starts, `beforeReorder` and `onReorder` each time the dragged child changes place, and `onReorderEnd` at the drop.

<a id="NodeReorderEvent-method-getIndex"></a>

### getIndex

`int getIndex()` 

Returns the index of the child after the move.
At `onReorderEnd`, the index where the child was dropped.

<a id="NodeReorderEvent-method-getChild"></a>

### getChild

`Node getChild()`

<a id="NodeReorderEvent-method-getPrevious"></a>

### getPrevious

`int getPrevious()` 

Returns the index of the child before the move.
At `onReorderEnd`, the index where the drag started.
